reason: The company is acquiring full economic interest in the Monte South project by purchasing the remaining 60% stake from Adani Group, consolidating control over a significant real estate asset.
why_now: The exchange filing confirming the acquisition was released on October 31, 2026.
source_headlines: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited: Acquisition of full economic interest in Monte South Project, Byculla by acquiring additional 60% stake in Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP ( SRTL ), a Joint Venture

Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 31, 2026, titled "Acquisition of Adani Group's 60% Stake in Monte South".
